description: This file 'secdownload.lua' is a Lua source file for a plugin that handles secure download functionalities within a larger web server or application environment. It defines a function for configuring access control with secrets, timeouts, and document roots, and registers an action named 'secdownload' that can be invoked within the server configuration.

methods.name: secdownload
methods.description: Configures a secure download handler with options like prefix, document root, secret, and timeout. It validates input parameters and sets up a handler via 'action.lua.handler'.
